backend_observation_config_reconciliatio: configured 22 equals checkpoint 22; no toggle needed for this model

fields.name: base_angular_velocity
fields.transform: sensor frame -> body; clip +/-100 then scale .25

fields.name: projected_gravity
fields.transform: world down rotated into body; clip +/-1

fields.name: velocity_command
fields.transform: clamped x/y/yaw command; not measured velocity

fields.name: track_mean_velocity
fields.transform: right mean(FR,RR), left mean(FL,RL); clip +/-100; scale .05

fields.name: joint_effort
fields.transform: RR,RL,FR,FL, right sum(FR,RR), left sum(FL,RL); clip +/-100; scale .01

missing_behavior: frontend requires flipper positions, two right and two left track velocities, effective IMU; state_timeout default 0.5 s; backend _source_joint_obs has zero defaults but frontend gate should block missing required fields
normalization: checkpoint obs_norm_state_dict if present; needs separate checkpoint inspection before model parity
timestamp: frontend callback reception time for freshness; message header stamp not propagated to backend
